findings.finding: The company's own monthly AUM disclosures put Q2 (Jul-Sep) average consolidated AUM about 5.7% above Q1 (month-ends Jun 13.98tn, Jul 13.84tn, Aug 14.25tn, Sep 13.97tn against Mar 12.15tn, Apr 13.02tn, May 13.69tn), so Q2 revenue and operating profit very likely print a new quarterly record above Q1's 12.82bn / 2.66bn and roughly three times last year's Q2 OP of 0.90bn on consolidation (Okasan from Sep 2025, Rheos from Dec 2025); September itself showed the first net outflow since April (-12.0bn yen) and AUM -2.0% on the month.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At Q1 (2026-07-27, 15:30, headline '経常3.4倍') the stock rose 2.44% close to next close; at Q3 FY26 (2026-01-29, '10-12月期も2.3倍') +1.28%; at Q2 FY26 (2025-10-27, with a 優待 expansion) +0.83%. Earlier record-growth prints in 2025 were sold (-0.93, -2.76). From Yahoo daily closes, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/4765.T?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly it is priced: the AUM series is public and the stock drifted -4.8% over 20 sessions after the 2026-09-30 merger notice, not up. What is not in the price is the YoY headline itself (kabutan will print 'H1 経常 ~3x / 7-9月期 ~3x'), which a retail-heavy, margin-long register reacted to at Q1 (+2.44%). If the record quarter were fully held, the stock would not be sitting at its 20-day lows with an unchanged 0% short register.
findings.independence: none: the quarterly profit series (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4765) gives Q1 OP 2,663m and Q2 FY26 OP 903m, which only supplies the comparison base, not a second line of evidence.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is mildly negative (-0.235, driven by the 8.89 margin overhang) and the 20-day run-up is -4.8%; the one finding is a small positive that partly cuts against both, but it rests on a public series. The strongest positive the release could carry would be a first full-year forecast or a 優待/returns announcement as at last year's H1; I looked and found no signal of either, and the dividend is already set, so this is close to a non-result.
